Ocean Trilogy Set - Great Barrier Reef III Clean Ocean Blue Whale

Oris Ocean Trilogy Set - a limited & numbered edition set of only 200 sets, with all 3 pieces sharing the same limited edition number. The trio of watches includes the: Oris Blue Whale limited edition 200 pieces, available exclusively as part of the Oris Ocean Trilogy set).Oris Great Barrier Reef III limited edition 2000 pieces.Oris Clean Ocean limited edition 2000 pieces.The set is delivered in an exclusive & eye-catching presentation box produced from used plastic bottles. Only chemically inert recycled plastic waste was selected as part of the process. The box is created in 4 steps: Use plastic bottles are collected.The plastic bottles are then shredded into small pieces.The pieces are selectively hand arranged & then pressed into a panel. The hand selection & positioning of the various colored bottle makes each panel unique.Finally the panels are cut to size & assembled as the outer shell of the Oris Ocean Trilogy presentation box .Oris Blue Whale 01 743 7734 4185-Set: Case diameter: 45.50Case back: Special engraving with Blue Whale image.Crown: screw down.Bezel: Blue ceramic with diving scale.Dial: Gradient blue dial, applied hour markers with luminous fill, hands with luminous fill.Water resistance: 500m.Features: Chronograph function, small seconds sub-dial at 9 o'clock, date window at 4.30 o'clock.Movement: Oris caliber 771 (base SW 510), beats at 28,800 vph, contains 27 jewels & has a power reserve of +/- 48 hours.Oris Great Barrier Reef III 01 743 7734 4185-Set: Case diameter: 43.50Case back: Special engraving with Blue Whale image.Crown: screw down.Bezel: Blue ceramic with diving scale.Dial: Gradient blue dial, applied hour markers with luminous fill, hands with luminous fill.Water resistance: 300m.Features: Central date indicator hand.Movement: Oris caliber 743 (base SW 220-1), beats at 28,800 vph, contains 28 jewels & has a power reserve of +/- 38 hours.Oris Clean Ocean 01 733 7732 4185-Set: Case diameter: 39.50Case back: Special engraving with medallion made of recycled PET plastics set into the case back.Crown: screw down.Bezel: Blue ceramic with diving scale.Dial: Gradient blue dial, applied hour markers with luminous fill, hands with luminous fill.Water resistance: 300m.Features: Date window at 6 o'clock.Movement: Oris caliber 733 (base SW 200-1), beats at 28,800 vph, contains 26 jewels & has a power reserve of +/- 38 hours.
